newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Failed nude Taiwan politico now plans nude nuptials.
newsitem.headline: Failed nude Taiwan politico now plans nude nuptials.

text.p: Taiwan's stripper politician Hsu Shao-tan said on Thursday she would wed in October and planned something typically flamboyant -- nude nuptials out of doors, with the public invited.
"I feel if a nation can appreciate and comfortably face the art of nudity, it will be a more open, happier and healthier nation," spinster Hsu told state television.
"This is the message I want to send through the wedding."

Hsu shot to fame as a candidate in Taiwan's early 1990s parliamentary elections with audacious stunts such as bursting naked through a flag of the ruling Nationalist Party and titillating voters with sexually suggestive slogans.
Though voters twice turned her down, Hsu has found her political pulpit by becoming a popular radio talk show host in southern Kaohsiung.
She still espouses nudity and has her fiancee's full backing. The couple will "dress" as Adam and Eve at the altar, she said.
Tickets to her wedding would be cheap, she added.
"I'm not sure how many people would like to come," she said. "We're thinking of selling tickets for T$1,000 (US$36) a head."
